title: Book 5 — Terpsichore, Chapter 120
paragraphs: While they were taking counsel in this way, the Milesians and their allies came to their aid. The Carians then set aside the plans they had been considering and prepared to start the war afresh; and when the Persians came against them, they engaged them in battle, and were beaten even more severely than before. Many fell on all sides, but the Milesians suffered worst.
